groups.title: Microsoft SC-900
groups.description: This mock mirrors the official SC-900: a scaled score out of 1000 with a passing bar of 700. Microsoft uses difficulty-weighted scaling; this practice test approximates it by weighting all 50 questions equally (20 points each), so 35 correct = 700. Questions are drawn at random from a larger bank and reshuffled each attempt. Multiple-response questions must be fully correct to earn points. You can flag questions and revisit them before submitting. At the end you’ll get a pass/fail result, a per-domain breakdown, and full explanations.

exams.description: This practice test mirrors the real AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) format: 65 questions in 90 minutes, of which 50 are scored and 15 are unscored pretest items — you won’t know which is which, exactly like the real exam. Only the 50 scored questions count toward a scaled score out of 1000, where 700 is a pass (this mock weights all scored questions equally, so 35 correct = 700). Questions are drawn at random from a larger bank across the four course modules and reshuffled each attempt. Multiple-response questions must be fully correct to earn the point. You can flag questions and revisit them before submitting. At the end you get a pass/fail result, a per-module breakdown and full explanations.

exams.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner - Final Exam (CLF-C02)
exams.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner - Final Exam
exams.subtitle: Full CLF-C02 mock · questions distributed across the four official exam domains by their real weightings
exams.description: This is a full CLF-C02 mock exam. Like the real exam it has 65 questions in 90 minutes; 50 scored plus 15 unscored pretest items you can’t identify, and reports a scaled score out of 1000 with 700 to pass (this mock weights all 50 scored questions equally, so 35 correct = 700). Crucially, the 50 scored questions are distributed across the four official domains by their real weightings: Cloud Concepts 24% (12 questions), Security & Compliance 30% (15), Cloud Technology & Services 34% (17) and Billing, Pricing & Support 12% (6). Questions are drawn at random from a larger bank and reshuffled each attempt. Multiple-response questions must be fully correct. Flag and revisit questions before submitting; at the end you get a pass/fail result, a per-domain breakdown and full explanations.
